ocr.text: * What motivated the author to produce the source?
Audience * Was it meant to be public or private?
* Was it intended to be a factual account of an event?
Intent * Was it meant to persuade?
* What was happening when the individual wrote the document?
* Was there any sort of intimidation or distress?

translations.target: * Bối cảnh của tác giả là gì?

translations.source: * What motivated the author to produce the source?
translations.normalizedSource: * What motivated the author to produce the source?
translations.target: * Điều gì đã thúc đẩy tác giả sản xuất nguồn tài liệu này?
* Ai là đối tượng của tài liệu này?

translations.source: Audience * Was it meant to be public or private?
translations.normalizedSource: Audience * Was it meant to be public or private?
translations.target: Đối tượng * Nó được viết cho công chúng hay riêng tư?
* Tại sao tài liệu này được viết?

translations.source: * Was it intended to be a factual account of an event?
translations.normalizedSource: * Was it intended to be a factual account of an event?
translations.target: * Nó có phải là một bản tường thuật sự kiện chính xác không?

translations.source: Intent * Was it meant to persuade?
translations.normalizedSource: Intent * Was it meant to persuade?
translations.target: Mục đích * Nó có nhằm thuyết phục không?

translations.source: * What was happening when the individual wrote the document?
translations.normalizedSource: * What was happening when the individual wrote the document?
translations.target: * Đã có điều gì xảy ra khi cá nhân viết tài liệu này?

translations.source: * Was there any sort of intimidation or distress?
translations.normalizedSource: * Was there any sort of intimidation or distress?
translations.target: * Có bất kỳ sự đe dọa hay lo lắng nào không?
